messages:
olivia_finance: Heads up — reseller reported a billing mismatch for GCP Marketplace invoice. They were charged for 300 seats but partner dashboard shows 275 with 10 pending activations. Can we audit?

dan_partners: ouch. invoice id? reseller and subscription?

olivia_finance: invoice INV-2026-05-08-res-77, reseller: channel-acme, subs: res-sub-77. Billing shows 300 seats @ $18 = $5,400. Partner UI export shows 275 active, 10 pending (not yet accepted), 15 trial seats.

ingest-bot: Invoice INV-2026-05-08-res-77 created (300 seats). Billing snapshot run at 2026-05-01T00:00:00Z.

mike_billing: can you paste the raw export? need event timestamps for accepted vs pending.

olivia_finance: pasted csv (redacted):
2026-04-30T23:59:59Z,res-sub-77,active:250
2026-05-01T08:10:12Z,res-sub-77,accepted:+25
2026-05-02T12:03:45Z,res-sub-77,pending:+10
2026-05-03T09:00:00Z,res-sub-77,trial:+15

olivia_finance: Looks like the accepted +25 happened after our midnight snapshot. But why did invoice include them?

mike_billing: suspects: 1) downstream reconciliation job merged later accepted events into snapshot incorrectly 2) duplicate seat mapping for trial flagging 3) partner pushed an override record. I'll check ingestion logs for snapshot job and reconciliation merge.

dan_partners: reaching out to reseller ops; they confirm the +25 were accepted at 08:10 UTC and shouldn't be billed for May period until next invoice.

ingest-bot: Created ticket TCK-5012: "GCP reseller snapshot merge included post-snapshot accept events - res-sub-77" assigned to eng-ops.

olivia_finance: AP holding payment until reconciliation. Finance approves provisional credit up to $1,000 pending root cause.

mike_billing: quick mitigation: add guard to snapshot merge that ignores event.ingest_time > snapshot_time unless event.event_time < snapshot_time and verified.

dan_partners: noted. I'll push partner to provide proof of acceptance timestamps for our audit.

olivia_finance: thanks team — will update ticket when we have final numbers and issue credit memo if needed.
